title: camera_add
description: Add a PTZ camera, or replace one added before with the same id. VISCA over IP, raw VISCA over TCP, ONVIF and Canon CR-N are spoken; fake is a camera with no hardware, for trying the window. Give `source`, the mixer source that shows the camera, for presets with pictures and for tracking.

protocol.description: How the camera is spoken to.

address.description: The camera's IP address, with :port when it is not the protocol's usual one (52381 for VISCA over IP, 5678 for VISCA over TCP, 80 for ONVIF and Canon). For ONVIF a device service URL also works.

user.description: The camera's login, for ONVIF and Canon.

password.description: The camera's password. Kept in the plugin's data directory.

profile.description: ONVIF only: the media profile token to steer. The first when left out.

source.description: The mixer source showing this camera's picture.

bus.description: Linux and macOS: a frame bus name to read the picture from instead of the mixer, the cheapest way in.
